messages:
Ava: Who's up for a midnight bracket watch + pancake breakfast this Saturday? low-key pot, $5 buy-in. link to bracket: https://brackets.example/office-2026 :pancakes: 
Diego: i'm in if there are real maple syrup options. also can we run the watch on the rooftop projector? :movie_camera:
Priya: i'll bring a griddle and vegan pancakes. sign me up for 2 batches. :raised_hands: 
Sam: love it. can someone remind me which channel we use to submit picks? last time i accidentally picked the underdog for all slots. :sweat_smile:
Marta: @Sam it's the bracket bot — `!join office-bracket` (or click the link). i'll post the invite again. 
OpsBot: Reminder: kitchen closes at 00:15. If you're bringing perishable food, please add it to the kitchen sign-up: https://intranet.example/kitchen-signup. 
Ava: ok i'll add pancakes + orange juice to the signup (1 griddle space reserved). 
Diego: also, small side-game: "last-second three" pool. $2 a guess on who hits a buzzer beater each game. winner gets the jar + bragging rights. :moneybag: 
Priya: can we do a tiny fantasy waiver trade before the games? i've got a soft spot for last-minute swaps. @Marta want to swap picks for the 8PM slot? 
Marta: depends — what are you offering? :thinking_face: 
Priya: my first-round upset pick (Syracuse) for your safe seed (Villanova). i'll throw in an extra pancake batch if you take Syracuse. :grin:
Marta: tempting. ok i'll take the pancake incentive and the upset pick. deal. :handshake:
Sam: FYI — i'll stream the spreadsheet scoreboard to the projector. bringing HDMI cable and duct tape. 
Ava: perfect. see y'all Saturday 11:45pm. if anyone wants to volunteer to be head pancake flipper, speak now or forever hold your syrup. :joy: 
Diego: volunteering. i'm a messy but enthusiastic flipper. :raised_hands::maple_leaf: 
OpsBot: Event created: "Midnight Bracket + Pancake Watch" — Calendar invite sent to #random. 
Marta: who wants to handle cleanup? i'll chip in with napkins and trash bags. 
Priya: i'll do cleanup shift 1 (post-games). Sam you okay with scoreboard teardown? 
Sam: yep, scoreboard teardown is mine. let's make this quick and not set off the office smoke alarm this time. :grimacing:
